resources.string: Track titles and artists are sent to the service you choose, and only while a service is signed in and switched on. Nothing is sent before that.
Songs played in Telos Music, after half of the song or 4 minutes
The current track of a station, after it was heard for one minute. Only works with stations that announce the track.
Nothing is sent: no service is signed in and switched on
Nothing is sent: switch on music or radio scrobbling
The server address must start with https:// (http is only allowed for a server in your own network)
